benches.name: emb_exact
benches.cmd:
B={RUN}/bsrc_m5_0; rm -rf $B && mkdir -p $B && for d in *; do ln -s $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && for d in $(cd physical/ref_tile/qfd_io_emb_tap_m5/src && ls -d */ | tr -d /); do rm -f $B/$d; cp -a $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && cp -a physical/ref_tile/qfd_io_emb_tap_m5/src/. $B/ && cd $B && { mkdir -p {RUN}/bench && $HOME/.local/opentallas-tools/verilator-5.050/bin/verilator --binary --timing -O1 -Wno-fatal -Wno-WIDTH -Wno-UNUSED -Wno-PINMISSING -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-LATCH -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-BLKSEQ -Wno-UNOPTFLAT -j 4 --top-module tb_qfd_embedding_rom  --Mdir {RUN}/bench/emb_exact rtl/test/qwen_rtl_finish/tb_qfd_embedding_rom.sv rtl/qwen_sys/rtl_finish_20261007/ot_qfd_io_embedding_rom.sv && {RUN}/bench/emb_exact/Vtb_qfd_embedding_rom
}
benches.note: [m5rr: run on the c1e4eba84 snapshot overlay of physical/ref_tile/qfd_io_emb_tap_m5/src]
